source_order.result: The official Constitution, Rajendra N. Shah judgment, current Multi-State Co-operative Societies Act and 2023 amendment framework, Ministry/CRCS, RBI and NABARD material were rechecked on 25 August 2026. National Cooperation Policy 2025 is a dated policy anchor, not a transfer of State legislative competence.

pyq_audit.status: Exact wording is retained where held; neutral routed wording and doctrinal solutions are labelled when official keys/models are unavailable.

current_affairs_audit.fact: The official Constitution, Rajendra N. Shah judgment, current Multi-State Co-operative Societies Act and 2023 amendment framework, Ministry/CRCS, RBI and NABARD material were rechecked on 25 August 2026. National Cooperation Policy 2025 is a dated policy anchor, not a transfer of State legislative competence.
current_affairs_audit.caveat: After Rajendra N. Shah, Part IXB cannot be written as a uniform binding code for ordinary State-field cooperatives. Article 19(1)(c), Article 43B and the valid multi-State field survive; Ministry, Registrar, financing, representative and operating cooperative bodies remain legally distinct.
